verdict.rationale: The only support is that notes can be exported to open formats like Markdown or HTML, which the founder also confirms. That gives a manual way to read your data without the app. Nothing shows the notes actually live in user-owned local files or a local-first store, and nothing addresses offline use. Missing for 10: notes stored natively as local files or in a local-first store, documented full offline functionality, independent hands-on confirmation of offline/local behavior.
